meta.title: Skip async runtime when no streams
meta.body_summary: Optimize compiler output by detecting stream/agent usage and skipping async _waitAll when not needed; update golden test outputs.

perf_labels.notes: Single-commit optimization to skip async runtime in generated code when no streams used; test golden outputs update; merged within minutes with no review.

core_change_summary.description: In compile/py/compiler.go and compile/ts/compiler.go, added detection logic for stream/agent usage in the program; when no streams are used, the generated main function is synchronous and _waitAll is omitted. Updated 44 golden output test files to match new generated code.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: 44 golden output test files were updated to reflect the removal of async _waitAll in programs without streams; these are test expectation changes.
